keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «바다가 플라스틱으로 가득해 용이 숨을 쉴 수 없었다(문제)» 와 «함께 힘을 모으면 사랑하는 것을 지킬 수 있다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the sea was full of plastic, so the dragon could not breathe) and the lesson (working together, people can save what they love). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Jiho, an old dragon, the people of the town
The sea was full of plastic, and the dragon was very weak.
Working together, people can save what they love.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why could the dragon not breathe?
qs.qko: 용은 왜 숨을 쉴 수 없었나요?
opts: The sea was full of plastic.
Jiho woke it up too early.
evs: Inside, a tired old dragon lay on the rocks.
"The sea is full of plastic," the dragon said weakly. "I cannot breathe."
People in Jeju say a dragon once lived under Hallasan Mountain.
On the full moon, the dragon rose from the waves, strong again.
why: 용이 «바다가 플라스틱으로 가득해. 숨을 쉴 수가 없구나»라고 말했어요. 동굴이 추웠다거나 지호가 깨웠다는 말은 없어요.
The dragon said, «The sea is full of plastic. I cannot breathe.» Nothing says the cave was cold or that Jiho woke it up.

qs.q: The story says, "The full moon was only three days away." What does "three days away" mean here?
qs.qko: "The full moon was only three days away."라는 문장이 있어요. 여기서 "three days away"는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: it would come in only three days
it was far away from Jeju
evs: "If the sea is not clean by the full moon, I will disappear forever."
Nobody believed it, until Jiho found a huge blue scale on the beach.
At first, nobody listened to him.
It flew around the island and roared, "Thank you!"
why: 용은 보름달이 뜰 때까지 바다가 깨끗해져야 한다고 했어요. «three days away»는 보름달까지 사흘밖에 남지 않았다는 뜻이에요.
The dragon said the sea had to be clean by the full moon. «Three days away» means the full moon would come in only three days.

qs.q: Why did the town finally help Jiho?
qs.qko: 마을 사람들은 왜 마침내 지호를 도왔나요?
opts: Jiho showed them the dragon's blue scale.
The dragon flew into town to ask for help.
The town wanted to win a prize.
evs: Then he showed them the blue scale.
Inside, a tired old dragon lay on the rocks.
Soon, the whole town cleaned the beach day and night.
It flew around the island and roared, "Thank you!"
why: 처음에는 아무도 듣지 않았지만, 지호가 파란 비늘을 보여 주자 곧 마을 사람 모두가 바닷가를 청소했어요. 두 문장을 이으면 답이 나와요.
At first nobody listened, but after Jiho showed them the blue scale, the whole town soon cleaned the beach. Put these two sentences together to find the answer.

ends: The dragon gives Jiho a ride around Jeju Island.
용이 지호를 태우고 제주도를 한 바퀴 날아요.
Jiho starts a beach clean-up day every month.
지호가 매달 바닷가 청소의 날을 만들어요.

write.src: “If <u>we all work together</u>, we can <u>keep our beach clean</u>.”
slotKo: 그러면 함께 할 수 있는 일
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «모두가 하는 일 + 그러면 함께 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what everyone does and what we can do together in English.

chips.a: everyone picks up one piece of trash
chips.label: trash

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «If» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을 한다», «we can» 뒤에는 동사로 시작해 보세요. (예: we can save the sea animals)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «If», write who + what they do. After «we can», start with a verb. (e.g. we can save the sea animals)

img.cover: Under a bright full moon, a huge old dragon with shiny blue scales, a long white beard and gentle golden eyes rises out of the sparkling waves and flies over Jeju Island, while a ten-year-old Korean boy with short wavy black hair, a blue-and-white striped T-shirt, yellow shorts and sandals and many smiling townspeople cheer and wave on a clean, empty beach.

scenes.1: Inside a dark sea cave, a huge old dragon with shiny blue scales, a long white beard and gentle golden eyes lies weakly on the rocks, tangled in plastic bottles, bags and old ropes, while a ten-year-old Korean boy with short wavy black hair, a blue-and-white striped T-shirt, yellow shorts and sandals kneels beside its big head with a worried face.
scenes.3: On the beach at night, a ten-year-old Korean boy with short wavy black hair, a blue-and-white striped T-shirt, yellow shorts and sandals and the whole town, from grandmas to little kids, pick up plastic bottles and old fishing nets and fill big bags, while an almost-full moon shines over the sea.

alt.3: A boy and the whole town clean the beach at night.
